caption:
The charity this verse asks of you

Allah tells us we will never attain righteousness until we spend from what we love, and that whatever we spend, He knows it. Tonight, think of one thing you love that could also bring good to someone else.

Surah Aal-i-Imraan 3:92

Pick one thing you love and share some of it this week

#sadaqah #spendwhatyoulove #surahaliimran #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
